title.narrative: This project aims to develop practical approaches for developing countries to integrate gender-responsive climate measures into their WPS NAPs. The research will also establish links between the mandates of the WPS Agenda and climate change, focusing on climate impacts in developing, fragile, and conflict-affected contexts to illustrate why a climate lens is critical to issues of women, peace and security.

Practical guidance for developing countries to integrate climate considerations into WPS NAPs is developed, as well as recommendations for how to strengthen interventions in developing countries affected by both conflict and climate impacts.

target.value: Analysis of current WPS NAPs that reference climate change, only 1 in four as of 2020, NAP processes that are attempting to integrate a climate lens, and existing NAP tools, including Inclusive Securitys WPS NAP tools, to develop guidelines and identify entry points for the inclusion of climate security considerations.

actual.value: Additional research needed. Work on both of these [NAP] briefs has begun, and first drafts are expected at the end of January 2024 and February 2024, respectively.

target.value: Develop concrete guidelines for developing countries to integrate climate considerations into WPS NAPs to be shared through toolkit/policy note/or alternate format. 2. Develop an Action Plan or policy brief that emphasizes the links between the mandates of the WPS agenda and climate change, with specific guidance/recommendations for how to strengthen interventions in developing countries.

title.narrative: Develop concrete recommendations for to better support and protect women in fragile or developing countries facing violent backlash for their efforts to advance women’s rights and engage in political and civic life.

Policy brief outlining recommendations for operational and policy interventions is developed from GIWPS’ research and analysis of violence against women engaged in political and civic life in fragile or developing countries.

target.value: GIWPS develops a research project to analyse trends in democratic backsliding/rising authoritarianism, shrinking civic space, backlash against gender equality, and violence against women in political and civic life from a WPS perspective.

Develop policy brief with analysis of trends and concrete recommendations for policymakers to strengthen efforts to protect women engaged in political and civic life in fragile or developing countries, which is foundational to womens meaningful participation in decision-making and a core priority of the WPS Agenda.

title.narrative: WPS analysis of gendered conflict dynamics and impacts in 2-3 developing countries.
2-3 profiles of developing countries experiencing conflict based on a WPS analysis.

target.value: Develop 2-3 country profiles of developing countries experiencing conflict based on WPS analysis. Countries are TBD, but could include Afghanistan, Ukraine, Myanmar, Ethiopia, South Sudan, Colombia, etc.
Use WPS lens to identify key trends and conflict dynamics to monitor in selected developing countries; develop analytical framework needed to systematically build country profiles.

actual.value: Research still under way. In early 2024, the frameworks will be used to finalize the data and analysis that comprise the Tracker. Following the completion of the frameworks, GIWPS will begin developing in-depth country profiles for a subset of the 25 countries.

title.narrative: Development of evidence-based guidance to inform efforts to address WPS challenges in fragile, conflict-affected and developing contexts.

Policy brief outlining concrete recommendations to better support and protect women in fragile or developing countries who are facing violent backlash for their efforts to advance women’s rights and engage in political and civic life. 2. Policy brief (or alternate document format) detailing practical guidance for developing countries to integrate gender-responsive climate considerations into WPS NAPs. 3. Action Plan or policy brief that emphasizes the links between the mandates of the WPS agenda and climate change, with specific guidance/recommendations for how to strengthen interventions in developing countries. 4. 2-3 profiles of developing countries experiencing conflict based on a WPS analysis.

target.value: GIWPS has developed and shared concrete, actionable guidance across these issues to promote inclusive approaches that lead to better WPS outcomes in fragile, conflict-affected and developing contexts.
